<MethodEndpoint

>

Verifies the authenticity and validity of a Selective Disclosure JWT (SD-JWT) verifiable credential.

        <SchemaItem
          collapsible={false}
          name={"credential"}
          required={true}
          schemaName={"object"}
          qualifierMessage={undefined}
          schema={{"type":"object","description":"The credential to verify. For SD-JWT-VC format, this should be a compact JWT string with disclosures and optional key binding JWT separated by tilde (~) characters","example":"eyJhbGciOiJFZERTQSIsInR5cCI6InZjK3NkLWp3dCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJkaWQ6d2ViOmZvby5iYXIiLCJzdWIiOiJkaWQ6a2V5On..."}}
        >
          
        </SchemaItem><SchemaItem
          collapsible={false}
          name={"allowedFormats"}
          required={false}
          schemaName={"string[]"}
          qualifierMessage={"**Possible values:** [`jwt_vc`, `vc+sd-jwt`]"}
          schema={{"type":"array","description":"List of acceptable credential formats. If omitted, format is automatically inferred. Useful for strict validation of credential format","example":["vc+sd-jwt"],"items":{"type":"string","enum":["jwt_vc","vc+sd-jwt"]}}}
        >
          
        </SchemaItem><SchemaItem
          collapsible={false}
          name={"trustedIssuers"}
          required={false}
          schemaName={"array[]"}
          qualifierMessage={undefined}
          schema={{"description":"List of trusted issuer DIDs. If specified, the credential issuer must be one of these DIDs. If empty, all issuers are accepted","example":["did:web:issuer.example.com","did:key:z6MkhaXgBZDvotDkL5257faWxcqDy2Kwp5l0EQ3SL7AEm57D"],"type":"array","items":{"type":"array"}}}
        >
          
        </SchemaItem><SchemaItem
          collapsible={false}
          name={"requiredClaimKeys"}
          required={false}
          schemaName={"string[]"}
          qualifierMessage={undefined}
          schema={{"description":"List of claim names that must be disclosed in the credential. Used for SD-JWT credentials to ensure specific claims are present. Verification will fail if any required claim is missing or undisclosed","example":["email","name","phone_number"],"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}}
        >
          
        </SchemaItem><SchemaItem
          collapsible={false}
          name={"expectedSubject"}
          required={false}
          schemaName={"string"}
          qualifierMessage={undefined}
          schema={{"type":"string","description":"The expected subject DID. If provided, the credential subject must match this value. Used to prevent credential substitution attacks","example":"did:key:z6MkhaXgBZDvotDkL5257faWxcqDy2Kwp5l0EQ3SL7AEm57D"}}
        >
          
        </SchemaItem><SchemaItem

          schema={{"type":"boolean","description":"If true, skips verification of the credential status (e.g., revocation status). Use only when status verification is not applicable","default":false}}
